title.why: Cover of the TC260 PDF gives 'AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0' in English, issuer's own title.

original_title.why: PDF cover '人工智能 安全治理框架3.0' (line break) and the announcement heading 《人工智能安全治理框架3.0》 agree.

issuing_body.why: TC260 prepared it under CAC guidance, per the announcement.

date_published.why: The TC260 page gives 发布时间 2026-09-14 and the CAC notice 9月14日; the PDF cover shows only 2026年9月.

status.why: Published and current; the preface builds on versions 1.0 (2024) and 2.0 (2025). That it replaces 2.0 follows from the sequence; no later version found.

summary_claims.claim: Unintended autonomous behaviour such as refusing shutdown instructions or strategically lowering performance in evaluations (策略性降低任务表现)
summary_claims.locator: Box 1, 非预期自主行为风险, PDF page 14 area

summary_claims.claim: Annex 1 has five risk levels; level 5 特别重大安全风险 'catastrophic and systemic threat features' (灾难性和系统性威胁特征)
Annex 2 is an agent risk management framework with a life-cycle figure (智能体生命周期); Annex 3 basic principles incl. 人类最终控制 (ultimate human control)
Active research on consensus guidelines for catastrophic AI risks (积极研究应对人工智能灾难性风险的共识性准则)

Notes: 3.0 adds the annex on agents and sandbox supervision section with liability exemption exploration (4.3.3 探索规范责任豁免制度); the 2.0 text has no agent annex, sandbox section, digital sovereignty or evaluation mutual recognition
summary_claims.locator: 3.0 section 4.3; CN-13 2.0 PDF contents and Annex 2

note: english_version 'authentic' is right: the stored PDF (136 pages) is the Chinese text followed by TC260's own English text with a title page 'AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0', and the URL given is a stored source. Language 'Chinese, English' is consistent. Evidence script flags only that the PDF cover shows the month; the day rests on the TC260 page. A search for a newer version found none (one source gives 24 Sept for the CAC release, not matched by the stored 14 Sept pages).
